problems: The hand coil reads as a metal spring or a hose, not a coiled rope. Its five turns are the same size, evenly spaced and stacked deep in a long helix, so after the turn the coil looks like a tube. Change it to a tight, shallow bundle of turns in slightly different sizes. The turns should sag into a teardrop shape, the way a coil hangs when it is held.

The free tail and the lead to the honda leave the coil at the same point, at its lower right. They cross into a pinched V tangle under the coil, so you can't tell which strand goes where. Make the tail leave from the lower left and hang free, and make the lead leave from the lower right and go down to the honda.
The tail's whipped end hangs right beside the honda. The cream ball and the cream eye blur into one small cluster. Move the tail end further left, away from the honda.

Framing: the shape is wide and short (loop beside the coil), so the width fills the frame and the hero takes only about half the card's height. Placing the coil above and to the left of a taller loop gives a roughly square outline that fills about 80% by 75%.

The five coil turns sit only 0.02 apart in depth with a rope 0.048 thick, so they merge into one thick donut and read as a spring or ring instead of a coil of rope. The fix spreads them in depth and gives each turn a different size so the separate turns show.
The lead from the coil to the honda has a sharp zig-zag kink at the coil's lower right. The fix runs it in one smooth curve that enters the honda along the loop's direction.

The coil is small next to the loop, and the loop passes straight behind the coil's right edge, so the two blur into one figure. The fix makes the coil larger and has it overlap only the loop's upper-left rim.
